description:
Is Crimson Desert Overhyped?
In this video, I want to talk about whether CrimsonDesert is actually overhyped or not. This game is at an all time high for hype and there are tons of videos coming out from content creators. There are new gameplay footage being revealed. We're just under a month now from the release of the game and I do want to take a look whether it might be overhyped or not. This is not to shit on the gmae or say anything bad about it or anything like that. It's simply a conversation about whether this game can meet the expectations of its rabid fan base of it cant.
